content: अतन्त्र {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ ब˚</sab>] .²1 Having no ropes or musical strings (as a musical instrument); नातन्त्री वाद्यते वीणा <ls>Rām.</ls> .²2 Unrestrained; not necessarily binding; not being the object of the rule under consideration; ह्नस्वग्रहणमतन्त्रम्, क्लीबत्वं ˚न्त्रम् <ls>Sk.</ls> Something which is not intended; on which there is no emphasis or stress (<ls>Vārttika 2. 2. 34. 1</ls>). .²3 Without formulas or empirical actions. .²4 Not (having the binding force of) a scientific statement; तत्राविज्ञातग्रहणमतन्त्रमिति कल्प्येत . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 1. 7</ls>. .{@-त्वम्@} meaninglessness, superfluity, superfluous nature. किं तु इतरस्मिन् पक्षे बाध्यतेतरां श्रुतिः . ऐन्द्रशब्दस्यातन्त्रत्वात् . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 4. 29</ls>.
